stem: Which sentence can replace sentence 2 to help develop the introduction to this story?

options.label: A
options.text: She had landed the perfect job, stocking shelves at a local grocery store.

options.label: B
options.text: She was glad she had found a job that allowed her to make it to swim team in the evenings.

options.label: C
options.text: She was a little chilly, so she was quite thankful that she had worn a jacket.

options.label: D
options.text: She looked carefully around the room, interested by everything that she saw in front of her.
